title: Vividly Smoked Argentinian Squid Empanadas
description: A tangy, juicy, cozy Argentinian dish featuring squid, shio-cure, egg-free-friendly. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the squid tubes, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well to coat the squid evenly.
In a separate bowl, mix the all-purpose flour with the butter until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the squid mixture and mix until just combined.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of the shio-cure in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the empanadas to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
